notes: Company: VS Code extension shipped to customers, ~140 active engineers using pre-release plugin.
Primary ask: streaming responses must support character-level flush for inline completions so typing + suggestion feel native.
Latency target: median keystroke->partial-suggestion <= 50ms; p95 <= 120ms under 250 concurrent sessions.
Model management: want stable/beta/dev channels with pinned model versions and automatic rollback on quality regression.
Auth flow: SSO-backed OIDC for developer accounts; extension will cache short-lived tokens locally and refresh silently.
Rate limits: worried about bursty behaviour when whole team opens workspaces; need clear rate-limit headers and quota per-user reporting.
Streaming transport: evaluating SSE vs websocket; prefer websocket for cancelability, but need Redwood guidance on connection count per host.
Caching: request-level prefix caching for repeated patterns (imports/snippets) could reduce token spend significantly.
Security: require audit logs for code suggestions and redaction controls to prevent leaking internal literals in completions.
Cost sensitivity: exploring dedicated capacity to stabilize latencies; want a forecastable commit with a 10% burst buffer.
Quote from product lead: "If a suggestion inserts the wrong license header once, customers notice — want deterministic filters."
Requested artifacts: SOC2 Type II report, KMS integration guide, sample token revocation flow for compromised devices.
POC plan: 1) integration of streaming endpoint into extension adapter, 2) run 2-hour load with 250 sessions, 3) evaluate suggestion accuracy drift across model pinning.
